bio: Inspired by Deepdrill Gemm's inventions, Grunid saw her escape from the monotony of Deepcast society. She was going to drill her way out. Toiling away in secret, she crafted her trusty drillbow and literally shot her way up through to the freedom of the surface. It's a whole new world up there – one where Grunid's finally in control.
